newsitem.title: UK: Fifth April North Sea Forties cargo cancelled - trade.
newsitem.headline: Fifth April North Sea Forties cargo cancelled - trade.

text.p: A fifth U.K. North Sea Forties cargo was cancelled on Wednesday because of underperformance at one of the fields feeding Britain's biggest crude stream, oil traders said.
Traders said it was unclear which cargo would join the list of cancelled loadings on April 14-16, April 17-19, April 18-20 and April 24-26.
"It has definitely been decided to cancel another cargo but the dates have not been fixed yet," said a trader.
The cancellation is likely to come in the last five days of the month, traders said.

Lower than expected output at the North Sea Scott field was responsible for the spate of cancellations which has cut the original April Forties loading programme to 39 cargoes, excluding crude piped straight to the Grangemouth refinery.
